related_questions.question: Is 7% a high mortgage interest rate?
related_questions.snippet: Historically, rates around 7% are not unusually high. Consider this St. Louis Fed (FRED) chart tracking Freddie Mac data on the 30-year, fixed-rate mortgage average. From the 1970s through the 1990s, such rates were more or less the norm, with a significant spike in the early 1980s.
